notes.title: V2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]1. Art Updates[/b]​[/p][olist][*][p]All battle maps redesigned with terrain adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Added hit-shake effects to combat animations[/p][/*][*][p]New grid overlay (adjust opacity in Settings)[/p][/*][/olist][p]​[b]2. Gameplay Changes[/b]​[/p][olist][*][p]Lightning strikes during storms no longer cause death[/p][/*][*][p]Post-Chapter 31 tournaments now grant Forging Scrolls (only for missed ones)[/p][/*][*][p]Growth System: Lock up to 2 attributes (guaranteed upgrade on level-up). Replaces Growth Amulets - now removed[/p][/*][*][p]Unequipped gear now sorts below currently equipped items[/p][/*][*][p]Manual saves now store deployment positions and unit selection[/p][/*][*][p]Support skill EXP now capped like tournaments (1st playthrough only)[/p][/*][*][p]Offensive skill damage increased. Skill slot cost set to 0[/p][/*][*][p]Map sprites now display correct facing direction[/p][/*][*][p]Hit calculation priority now exceeds Critical[/p][/*][*][p]Unit cap removed. Melee units +40 HP, Hybrid units +20 HP, Ranged units unchanged[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged weapons no longer benefit from Luck-based trait triggers[/p][/*][*][p]New Game+ added[/p][/*][*][p]6 new playable characters in New Game+[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized EN/JP translations[/p][/*][/olist][p]​[b]3. Character & Equipment Adjustments[/b]​[/p][olist][*][p]​[b]Zhang Fei[/b]: New skill \[Three Armies' Valor][/p][list][*][p]Cannot follow-up: 33/66/100% chance to follow-up[/p][/*][*][p]Can follow-up: +10/20/30% follow-up damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]​[b]Ma Chao[/b]: Reworked \[Death Pursuit][/p][list][*][p]SPD -3/6/9[/p][/*][*][p]33/66/100% chance to follow-up before enemy counter[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]​[b]Guan Yu[/b]: \[God of War] armor break → Critical[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Guan Ping[/b]: New passive \[Immovable Mountain][/p][list][*][p]If not moved: +2/4/6 Insight & Detection until move/chapter end[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]​[b]Lv Bu[/b]: \[Unrivaled General] no longer reduces MOV when using bows[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Zhou Cang[/b]: Trait changed from Iron Cavalry → Vanguard[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Wei Yan[/b]: Trait changed from Vanguard → Iron Cavalry[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]New Class \[Shadow Guard]​[/b]: AGI+4, MOV+1[/p][list][*][p]Lv10: EVA+20[/p][/*][*][p]Lv20: Counters ignore 100% DEF/Insight[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]​[b]Archer Officer[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Lv10: HIT+20 → Lv20: HIT+20[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]​[b]Mount Tai Soldier[/b]: "Reduce melee DMG" → "Reduce elemental DMG"[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Iron Cavalry Rework[/b]:[/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]Per 3/3/2/2/1 MOV: DMG+1 & ignore 10% DEF/Insight (melee)[/p][/*][*][p]At max: Full armor break after 10+ MOV[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]​[b]Vanguard[/b]: DEF → HIT. Melee DMG taken -30%[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Cautious[/b]: Ranged DMG reduction lowered to 25%[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Green Dragon Blade[/b]: Armor break → Critical[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]New Item \[Bamboo Talisman]​[/b]:[/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]Full HP: Melee DMG+30% / Ranged DMG+15%[/p][/*][/list]
